name: Discord
tagline: Communities, bots, interactions, webhooks, and REST/Gateway APIs.
shortDescription: Discord exposes bot, interaction, application command, webhook, REST, and Gateway APIs with public docs.
agentSummary: Agents can build bots, slash commands, and community workflows when token permissions and moderation are constrained.
bestFor: Community bots, support servers, internal chatops, and event-driven workflows.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Posting, moderation, and member data require clear permissions and rate-limit handling. Outbound messages, SMS, email deliverability, consent, unsubscribe behavior, private chats, and customer-facing replies need approval, throttling, and audit logs. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Store credentials outside source control and use least-privilege scopes, short-lived tokens, or restricted keys where the product supports them.
pricingSummary: Developer API is generally free; app monetization and premium features have separate rules.
authModel: Bot tokens, OAuth2, application commands, permissions, and webhook URLs.
browserSupport: Developer portal and server UI are needed for app setup and permissions.

capabilities.detail: REST API and Gateway support bots, interactions, webhooks, applications, and guild workflows.
Official docs include reference, changelog, OAuth, and interaction guides.
Developer API is generally free; app monetization and premium features have separate rules.
Developer portal and server UI are needed for app setup and permissions.
Test servers and development apps allow safer bot testing.
